protocol.higher_line_rule: last two confirmed high pivots form resistance and last two confirmed low pivots form support; project to current day/week from only prior completed higher-timeframe bars
protocol.entry: EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch signal on closed 1H/4H bar, near projected support with EMA slope bending up for long, or near projected resistance with EMA slope bending down for short; fill next open
protocol.exit: opposite EMA25 first-touch signal closes the current side even if higher-line filter blocks the replacement entry
protocol.control: same EMA25 0.5 ATR signal without higher-line filter, identical candles and costs
protocol.primary_screen: strictly positive return in every complete calendar month and fewer closed trades than EMA25 control
protocol.annual_screen: strictly positive return in each complete calendar year; incomplete 2026 shown separately
protocol.monthly_ex_post_regime: stock month return > +5% growth, < -5% decline, otherwise sideways only if monthly high-low range <=10% of first open; remaining months volatile_mixed; diagnostic only
protocol.annual_ex_post_regime: stock year return > +10% growth, < -10% decline, otherwise sideways only if yearly high-low range <=30% of first open; remaining years volatile_mixed; diagnostic only
protocol.candidate_policy: no strategy or paper account until monthly screen, cost review and manual TradingView reconciliation
protocol.baseline: same EMA25 0.5 ATR signal without higher-line filter, identical candles and costs
protocol.selection: no strategy or paper account until monthly screen, cost review and manual TradingView reconciliation

signal_rule.entry: EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch signal on closed 1H/4H bar, near projected support with EMA slope bending up for long, or near projected resistance with EMA slope bending down for short; fill next open
signal_rule.exit: opposite EMA25 first-touch signal closes the current side even if higher-line filter blocks the replacement entry

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.

blockers: нет варианта с минимум 100 акциями, тремя ранними и одним поздним месяцем
